status: PASS: complete source-only review of finite clique certificate helper
reviewed_reasoning: Validation enforces a loop-free symmetric bit adjacency graph with at most twelve vertices.
For the least vertex v of a nonempty subset S, every clique either avoids v or consists of v plus a clique in (S-v) intersect N(v), giving the exact two-child recurrence.
Both recurrence children strictly decrease the subset. Base value zero at the empty subset and replay of every reachable child prove the upper bound by induction.
The verifier requires exactly the reachable recurrence table, not merely a claimed top value. The independently checked clique has cardinality equal to the certified bound.
The empty graph yields the empty clique and maximum zero. Domain-specific interpretation and transitivity are outside this helper.
scope: Read-only helper review. No independent assertion about a particular Z-orbit graph or a fractional pair-moment point.
